Sketch Helper — Quick Reference

Your sketches

Everything is kept on this device only. Clearing the browser's data takes it all with it, as does closing the site in a private window. Export All (CSV) on the Sketches page is the way to keep a copy.

Drawing

Type a distance in the field in the middle of the arrows and tap an arrow: that draws a wall. Hold an arrow instead for the same direction at 15° either side. With nothing being drawn the arrows move what is chosen - an area, or the corners selected on one.

Sketch view

  • Choosing - tap an area to choose it, or a corner to pick that corner. The arrows then move what is chosen, a unit a tap.
  • Moving - drag a chosen area, or a picked corner, to carry it where the finger goes; it lands on the grid.
  • Panning and zooming - two fingers slide the sketch, and pinching them zooms it. One finger never pans: it belongs to whatever it lands on.
  • Areas that overlap - tap the same spot again to step to the next area under it, and again for the one after. With Select Areas armed the steps go on to all of them, then none, then round again.
  • Bare canvas - a tap clear of everything lets go of whatever is chosen, and shuts the area being drawn.
  • The red dot - the first point of the area being drawn. Tap it to close the area. A purple ring says there is a way round through the areas it touches: hold it to close along them. Without the ring, holding closes the area just as a tap does.

Buttons

A filled button is armed. A greyed one has nothing to do yet, and a glowing one will act on the tap.

  • Add - asks which: Add Area draws another area in this structure, Add Point drops a corner on a wall you tap, which slides along it one unit at a time, showing both new lengths, and lands when the tool is put away.
  • Remove - takes the selected area away. With corners selected it asks which to take: the corners or the area.
  • Close Area - shuts the open area. Hold it to close along the areas it already touches.
  • New Structure - closes what is open and starts a separate structure.
  • Draw Box - drag out a rectangle; the arrows go on moving the green corner.
  • Duplicate - copies what is selected, stacked where it stands.
  • Merge - merges the areas that are selected if touching.
  • Punch Out - takes the chosen area out of the one it lies over.
  • Select Multiple - asks which: Select Areas or Select Points. Tap them one by one, or drag a box round them.
  • Rotate - drag the knob to turn what is chosen, 15° at a time. An area cannot be moved while it is armed.
  • Polygon - draw an area by entering the number of walls and the wall length.
  • Cut - asks which: Point to Point Cut cuts between two corners you tap; Cut Lines casts a line from a corner with the arrows, and a second tap on Cut makes the cut. More than one line can be drawn so long as each crosses the one before.
  • ? - the explanation tool. Arm it and the next button tapped says what it does instead of doing it, then it puts itself away.
  • Undo and Redo - step back and forth through the sketch. They never touch saved sketches or their titles.
  • Arc - tap one, then tap the wall to curve. They raise and lower the curve, and stepping past flat pushes it through to the other side.
  • Save - keeps the sketch under the title beside it. Saving one opened from Sketches updates it; give it a different title first and it is filed as a second sketch instead.
  • Voice Commands - beside Save where the browser can listen. Say a distance and a direction - "twenty right" - or "undo", "close area", "new structure", "save", and "stop" to switch it off.
  • Label - swaps to Label Mode, where tapping an area names it: Order Type, Area Type and Sub-Type. Tap Edit to come back. Each area is named as it is finished; switch Autolabel popup off in Settings to be asked only here.

Holding

  • An arrow - the same direction at 15° either side.
  • Close Area - closes along the areas it touches.
  • An area on the sketch - reopens it to carry on drawing.

Menu

Sketches lists what you have saved, with Sort By, Export All (CSV) and Delete All; tap a picture to open it. Settings holds Haptic feedback, Button icons, Dark Mode, the Autolabel popup, which side the arrows sit on in each orientation, and Reset to default. Report a Bug opens your mail app with the sketch and a picture attached; Suggest a Feature sends your idea alone. Nothing leaves the device until you send the mail yourself.
